name: Clear day
text: on a clear sunny day, blue sky, crisp light

name: Fair weather clouds
text: under a bright blue sky dotted with small fluffy clouds, cloud shadows drifting across the land

name: Hazy sunshine
text: in hazy sunshine, milky pale sky, softened sun, gentle low-contrast shadows

name: Partly cloudy
text: under a partly cloudy sky, sun breaking through gaps, patches of light and shade moving over the ground

name: Overcast
text: under an overcast sky, flat gray clouds, soft diffused shadowless light, muted colors

name: Low clouds
text: under low heavy clouds, the cloud base hiding the hilltops, damp gray air, muted distance

name: Towering clouds
text: under towering cumulus clouds, billowing white heads, flat gray bases, deep blue sky between them

name: Wispy cirrus
text: under high wispy cirrus clouds, thin feathery streaks across a pale blue sky

name: Mackerel sky
text: under a mackerel sky, rippled rows of small white cloudlets covering the sky like fish scales

name: Lenticular clouds
text: under smooth lens-shaped lenticular clouds stacked over the peaks, otherwise clear sky

name: Gentle breeze
text: in a light breeze, {tall grass|curtains|flags|loose hair} gently stirring, soft ripples on the water

name: Windy
text: on a windy day, {hair and clothes blowing|trees bending|leaves swirling} in strong gusts, fast-moving clouds

name: Gale
text: in a fierce gale, spray torn from the waves, grass flattened, trees thrashing, clouds racing across the sky

name: Mist
text: in a light morning mist, soft haze rising from the ground, gentle veil over the distance, damp dewy air

name: Fog
text: in thick fog, soft muted shapes, fading distance

name: Sea fog
text: with a bank of sea fog rolling in from the water, the shoreline swallowed in gray, damp salty air

name: Sea of fog
text: above a sea of fog, white fog filling the valleys below, hilltops and trees rising out of it like islands

name: Freezing fog
text: in freezing fog, white rime ice coating branches and fences, pale frozen air, muted shapes

name: Haze
text: in dense haze, layers of distant hills fading into pale blue-gray, flattened depth, soft horizon

name: Smog
text: in thick brown smog, buildings fading into the murk, a dim orange sun disc, grimy heavy air

name: Drizzle
text: in a fine drizzle, tiny droplets beading on every surface, damp gray air, glistening pavements

name: Rain
text: in the rain, {light drizzle|heavy downpour}, wet reflective surfaces

name: Sun shower
text: in a sun shower, rain falling while the sun shines, glittering raindrops, bright gaps in the clouds

name: Driving rain
text: in driving rain, slanting streaks blown sideways by the wind, umbrellas straining, water streaming off every edge

name: Monsoon downpour
text: in a monsoon downpour, walls of warm heavy rain, flooded streets, overflowing gutters, water streaming everywhere

name: Rain on glass
text: seen through a rain-streaked window, droplets running down the glass, a blurred world beyond

name: After the rain
text: after the rain, glistening wet streets, puddles reflecting the sky, {a rainbow in the distance|clouds breaking apart}, fresh clean air

name: Dripping leaves
text: just after a shower, raindrops dripping from leaves, beads of water on petals and spider webs, damp dark earth

name: Approaching storm
text: with a storm approaching, a dark shelf cloud rolling across the horizon, still heavy air ahead of it

name: Storm
text: under a stormy sky, dark clouds, lightning in the distance

name: Thunderstorm
text: in a violent thunderstorm, bright forked lightning, torrential rain, churning black clouds, dramatic flashes of light

name: Dry lightning
text: under dry lightning, bolts flickering inside dark clouds over parched land, no rain reaching the ground

name: Supercell
text: beneath a supercell storm, a towering rotating cloud with layered bands, a wide anvil spreading at the top

name: Mammatus clouds
text: under mammatus clouds, rounded pouches hanging from the underside of a storm cloud, strange bulging sky

name: Funnel cloud
text: with a tornado funnel cloud touching down far away, dark greenish sky, swirling dust at its base

name: Tropical storm
text: in a tropical storm, palm trees bent double, horizontal rain, churning gray sea, ragged low clouds

name: Hail
text: in a hailstorm, white hailstones bouncing on the ground, icy pellets in the air, dark gray sky

name: Sleet
text: in cold sleet, half-frozen rain mixed with wet snow, gray slush on the ground, dripping icy edges

name: Snow flurries
text: in light snow flurries, scattered flakes whirling in the air, a thin white dusting on the ground

name: Snow
text: in falling snow, {gentle snowflakes|a raging blizzard}, frosty cold air

name: Wet snow
text: in wet snow, big heavy flakes clinging to branches, fences and clothes, white clumps on every ledge

name: Heavy snowfall
text: in heavy snowfall, dense curtains of falling flakes, snow piling high on roofs and cars, muffled white world

name: Blizzard
text: in a whiteout blizzard, snow driven sideways, no visible horizon, shapes vanishing into white

name: Drifting snow
text: in drifting snow, streams of snow blowing low across the ground, wind-sculpted drifts and ridges

name: Fresh snow
text: after a heavy snowfall, deep untouched snow, branches bowed under the weight, soft rounded shapes everywhere

name: Frost
text: on a frosty morning, white frost on grass and leaves, sparkling ice crystals, cold clear air, pale sunlight

name: Ice storm
text: after an ice storm, everything encased in clear glaze ice, icicles hanging from branches and wires, glittering surfaces

name: Diamond dust
text: in bitter cold air, tiny ice crystals glittering as they float, breath turning to steam

name: Summer heat
text: on a hot summer day, heat haze, bright light

name: Heatwave
text: in a scorching heatwave, shimmering mirage on the road, bleached white sky, cracked dry ground

name: Humid air
text: in heavy humid air, a damp sheen on every surface, beads of condensation, a soft steamy haze

name: Dust devil
text: with a dust devil spinning across dry ground, a twisting column of sand and dust, parched air

name: Dust storm
text: with a towering wall of brown dust rolling across the plain, the sky turning ochre ahead of it

name: Sandstorm
text: in a sandstorm, swirling dust and sand, orange hazy air, sun dimmed to a pale disc, low visibility

name: Rainbow
text: under a vivid rainbow arching across the sky, dark retreating rain clouds behind it

name: Double rainbow
text: under a double rainbow, a bright inner arc and a fainter outer arc, darker sky between them

name: Fogbow
text: with a pale white fogbow arching through thin fog, soft colorless bands, damp still air

name: Crepuscular rays
text: with sunbeams bursting through gaps in heavy clouds, distinct rays fanning down to the ground

name: Sun halo
text: with a large ring halo around the sun, a thin high veil of cirrus cloud, pale icy sky

name: Sun dogs
text: with bright sun dogs on either side of the sun, ice crystals in a cold hazy sky, a faint halo joining them

name: Aurora
text: under a shimmering aurora, ribbons of {green|green and violet|crimson and green} light rippling across a starry sky
